cases.prompt: Our Stripe client wrapper needs 2s timeouts, bounded retries, an idempotency key and signature verification for provider callbacks.
cases.reason: External-provider adapter contract (timeouts/retries/idempotency/signing) is the outbound sibling deliverable; the pattern advisor only owns placement/cost decisions.

cases.reason: Transaction boundary/scope, isolation, locking and compensation are transaction-scope-designer ownership; the pattern advisor only places patterns inside the application layer.
